Blender Foundation

Blender

Blender is an open-source suite for 3D modelling, animation, rendering and compositing.

Blender is available in the Vector OS beta. Supported features and host versions depend on your build.

Workflow ideas

Build an asset and scene

Start from the selected model, asset hierarchy and scale. In the intended Blender preview, build an asset and scene; the visible result is a composed scene with geometry and camera framing visible. Review object identity, silhouette and missing assets before accepting or exporting it.

Animate a mechanical sequence

Begin with the approved scene state, materials and motion intent. In the intended Blender preview, animate a mechanical sequence; the visible result is a lighting, animation or effects preview with changed controls exposed. Review timing, material response, collisions and visual continuity before accepting or exporting it.

Render and composite the result

Use the reviewed cameras, render settings and delivery format. In the intended Blender preview, render and composite the result; the visible result is a bounded presentation sequence or image comparison. Review frame content, colour, legibility and output specification before accepting or exporting it.
